messages:
customer-jones: hey team — getting a 403 calling POST /v1/embeddings for tenant acme-co. request id 01FXXXX. payload simple, model=embed-large, body size small. response: {\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\", \"message\":\"missing permission: inference.generate, rerank.score\"}. no changes on our side besides rotating the key via SSO yesterday.

nora_cs: thanks — sorry about that. can you paste the curl you used (redact the key) and the raw Authorization header you sent? also: did the SSO provisioner say which scopes it granted?

customer-jones: curl below (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_SERVICE_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-large\",\"input\":\"test\"}'
```
I checked our SSO admin UI — it showed scopes: `embeddings` only (we thought that meant embed+infer). we didn't see other options.

sara_oncall: that UI mapping is confusing. if the key only has the embedding claim, generation/rerank will 403. can you paste the decoded token payload (just the claims) or the proxy access log for the request id?

customer-jones: pasted decoded jwt claims from our side (redacted ids):
```
{\n  \"sub\": \"svc_acme_123\",\n  \"scopes\": \"embeddings\",\n  \"iss\": \"sso-acme\",\n  \"exp\": 1712345678\n}
```
we also saw our internal gateway add header `X-SSO-Scopes: embeddings` before forwarding.

ryan_eng: hm — looks like the provisioner normalized the scopes into a single string instead of an array. we've seen a bug where the SCIM connector or SSO CSV exporter collapses multi-valued scopes into one token when the delimiter is a space. product / provisioning UI can show `embeddings` which hides that `inference` and `rerank` weren't actually granted.

nora_cs: ok, two action items: (1) quick repro/fix so they can generate keys now, (2) long-term fix and a note for triage.

ryan_eng: repro steps for engineering and for customer to validate:
1) create a new service key in SSO provisioning and explicitly select: `inference:generate`, `embeddings:vector`, `rerank:score`.
2) confirm JWT claim `scopes` is an array or comma-separated list, e.g. \"scopes\": [\"inference:generate\",\"embeddings:vector\",\"rerank:score\"] or \"scopes\":\"inference:generate,embeddings:vector,rerank:score\".
3) curl test for generation and embed:
```
# embeddings
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer NEW_REDACTED\" -d '{\"model\":\"embed-large\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
# generation (should not 403)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer NEW_REDACTED\" -d '{\"model\":\"gen-medium\",\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'
```
If you still 403 on /v1/generate but embeddings works, inspect the claim to see if `inference:generate` is missing.

nora_cs: workaround for now: we can create a short-lived org-scoped service key with all three permissions and provide it to the customer while provisioning is fixed. would you like us to issue that? (it will be logged and expire in 24h)

customer-jones: yes please — that'd be great. can you also share how to check the claim format so we don't get surprised next time?

ryan_eng: quick check: paste the token (redact signature) into a jwt decoder or run `jwt decode --no-verify`. look for `scopes` type. if it's a string and contains commas or spaces, ensure the provisioning flow didn't drop tokens. our backend accepts either an array or comma-separated string. single-word `embeddings` means only embeddings.

nora_cs: issuing temporary key now — ticket #CS-12345 created. deploy-bot: created CS-12345 (priority P2).

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-12345 created by nora_cs.

customer-jones: received temp key, tested — generation + embed + rerank all ok. thanks 🙏

sara_oncall: we'll add a short doc snippet for SSO provisioning (how to pick multiple scopes) and a validation check in the provisioning pipeline to warn if you only selected `embeddings` but the UI shows a multi-scope dropdown. filing follow-up engineering bug.

ryan_eng: noting fix: change CSV exporter to use comma delim and set `scopes` claim to array when >1 value. will link PR in CS ticket.

customer-jones: appreciate the fast turnaround. leaving this thread open until the provisioning UI update is shipped.
